title: Task sync stage 2: active reconciliation with TermAl G1/G2 and both halves of G3
outcome: Task sync stage 2: active reconciliation with TermAl G1/G2 and both halves of G3
acceptance: Active reconciliation follows the sequence: durable hold, then settlement of the original execution/observations/exact intents under a persistent candidate-bound fence, then each holder releasing its own claim, then release-induced cleanup, then a fresh candidate-bound readiness and readset barrier, then an atomic compare/apply that audits SupersededByImport retirement and reported state, keeping old evidence/seal ids and bytes

Candidate, root, run, claim, fence or basis mismatches and incomplete proof fail closed; held prompts stay retained; issued-but-unbegun or uncertain dispatch cannot escape; a missing stored Begin outcome stays pending unless exact-owner positively-unsent retirement or a serialized authoritative terminal outcome proves otherwise; recovery never runs a first provider execution

Tests join the real delivered G1/G2/G3 production seams (TermAl w-358040469407 and Engram w-42d16bae66ac), cover the release-induced cleanup race and final basis change, and reopen with a new generation and no claim; only this item closes the parent's active-reconciliation criterion
disposal_reason: Superseded by Greg's decision that TermAl has no part in Engram sync (memory rules-greg-full-sync-is-full-exchange-2026-11-07 rev 2: „Termal nie powien byc zaangazowany w engram sync”). Incoming changes to a task with a live local claim or run are held until it ends normally, with no TermAl G1–G3 attestation. Closed under rules-greg-close-senseless-tasks-2026-11-08; nothing is claimed as implemented.
